title: •Feltipern Trevagg’s Stun Rifle
caption: •Feltipern Trevagg’s Stun Rifle (V)
game_text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your bounty hunter (free on Feltipern Trevagg). May target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target captured (and you may take one Interrupt from Lost Pile into hand) if destiny +2 > defense value.
lore: Assault rifle modified by Feltipern. Used by the Gotal bounty hunter before he became a tax collector. Occasionally brought along to ‘ease’ Feltipern’s collection duties.

notes: Unique. Curly apostrophe in heading and caption (Trevagg’s). Green Character Weapon frame, banner CHARACTER WEAPON. No inline icons; slip text matches the stub. Lore corrected from scan: curly single quotes around ‘ease’ and curly apostrophe in Feltipern’s (wiki straight). 'bounty hunter' in the lore is not visibly bold on the 350 px scan (weapon lore; left plain). Base scan only at 350 px. Copyright line not legible on the 350 px scan; set-convention form. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px).
